input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p='hammerspoon/init.lua'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

# 4. job carries its destination
old = '''        lang       = nil,   -- first detected language across all segments'''
new = '''        lang       = nil,   -- first detected language across all segments
        target     = nil,   -- focusTargetId() of where the text belongs, taken at key release'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

# 5. pipeTakePending carries the destination too
old = '''local function pipeTakePending()
    if #pipeJobs.pending == 0 then return nil, nil end
    local parts, lang = {}, nil
    for _, p in ipairs(pipeJobs.pending) do
        table.insert(parts, p.text)
        lang = lang or p.lang
    end
    for i = #pipeJobs.pending, 1, -1 do pipeJobs.pending[i] = nil end
    return table.concat(parts, " "), lang
end'''
new = '''local function pipeTakePending()
    if #pipeJobs.pending == 0 then return nil, nil, nil end
    local parts, lang = {}, nil
    local target = pipeJobs.pending[1].target
    for _, p in ipairs(pipeJobs.pending) do
        table.insert(parts, p.text)
        lang = lang or p.lang
        -- Dictations aimed at different places have no single destination left between them:
        -- "" matches no focus, so the whole batch takes the clipboard route.
        if p.target ~= target then target = "" end
    end
    for i = #pipeJobs.pending, 1, -1 do pipeJobs.pending[i] = nil end
    return table.concat(parts, " "), lang, target
end'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

# 6. pipeFlushPending
old = '''    local text, lang = pipeTakePending()
    if not text then return false end
    log("pipeline: flushing a queued dictation (" .. #text .. " chars)")
    insertTranscribedText(text, lang)'''
new = '''    local text, lang, target = pipeTakePending()
    if not text then return false end
    log("pipeline: flushing a queued dictation (" .. #text .. " chars)")
    insertTranscribedText(text, lang, target)'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

# 7. pipelineFinalize: queue entry keeps its destination
old = '''            table.insert(pipeJobs.pending, { text = finalText, lang = job.lang })'''
new = '''            table.insert(pipeJobs.pending, { text = finalText, lang = job.lang, target = job.target })'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

old = '''        log("pipeline: gen " .. job.gen .. " inserting late -- the recorder is idle")
        if finalText ~= "" then insertTranscribedText(finalText, job.lang) end'''
if s.count(old)!=1:
    old = old.replace('--','—')  # em dash in source
new = '''        log("pipeline: gen " .. job.gen .. " inserting late — the recorder is idle")
        if finalText ~= "" then insertTranscribedText(finalText, job.lang, job.target) end'''
assert s.count(old)==1, repr(old)
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

# combined insert: the queued text rides along to the *current* dictation's destination
old = '''    local queued, queuedLang = pipeTakePending()'''
new = '''    -- The queued text rides along to this dictation's destination: the user is standing in
    -- it right now, having just spoken into it. Its own target is deliberately dropped.
    local queued, queuedLang = pipeTakePending()'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

old = '''    hs.timer.doAfter(0.4, hideProgressBar)
    insertTranscribedText(finalText, job.lang)'''
new = '''    hs.timer.doAfter(0.4, hideProgressBar)
    insertTranscribedText(finalText, job.lang, job.target)'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

# 8. capture at key release
old = '''    if not isRecording then return end
    isRecording = false
    log("recording: stop")'''
new = '''    if not isRecording then return end
    isRecording = false
    log("recording: stop")

    -- Pin down where this dictation is meant to go, while the user is still there. It is
    -- re-checked just before insertion; if it moved, the text goes to the clipboard.
    pipe.target = focusTargetId()
    log("insert: target at release: " .. tostring(pipe.target))'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print("part 2 ok")
PY
grep -c '^local ' hammerspoon/init.lua
input.description: Thread the target through the pipeline and capture at release
